implementation.custody: Trusted owner-local fixed profile and matching public fingerprint/ternary secret metadata. No key generation/export/serialization API. Reject use after fork, copying and closed contexts; share one custody handle across local client blocks without promoting a peer key.
implementation.key_pair_premise: The honest owner creates a valid pk/sk pair. Matching fingerprint and key ID do not prove the secret corresponds algebraically to the public key. Actual key generation and complete HE correctness remain in the future frozen cohort.
implementation.decoder: Reuse the existing homemade private_bgv.PrivateDecoder packed native backend. Initialize it only inside the current authenticated and consumed ResultClient callback; no raw public decrypt entry point, automatic fallback or received backend selection.
implementation.decoder_lifetime: At most one lazy native decoder per owner key-custody handle. Serialize decode/close across clients; keep owner close separate from per-block client close. Charge actual private preparation and lifetime in the exact execution addendum.
implementation.private_scope: Existing fixed-work native secret multiplication/centered reduction is supporting code, not assurance for Python import, secret copies, score handling, side channels, hardware or the complete new client. No secure-erasure promise for Python caller copies.
implementation.complete_finish: Validate every decoded physical lane and canonical plaintext residue; enforce zero unused plaintext tails, signed-score range/parity, all distances and top3 by original ordinal with bound IDs. Use linear-sized complete output and O(records*log(3)) selection.
implementation.failure: Malformed/foreign/stale/replayed receipts cannot initialize or invoke the private backend. Private callback failure remains coarse and consumed; no private exception/result is returned to a public role.
implementation.existing_sources: Preserve all 425 runtime-source, 66 company-file and six isolated-library baseline pins. Record the existing private native extension/dependencies separately; build nothing new.
